.. change::
    :tags: feature, engine

    Added :meth:`_engine.ScalarResult.freeze` and
    :meth:`_engine.MappingResult.freeze`, which return a new
    :class:`_engine.FrozenFilterResult` callable.  As with
    :meth:`_engine.Result.freeze`, the remaining contents of the result are
    fully consumed when the method is called, after which the underlying
    cursor may be closed; invoking the frozen object any number of times
    produces new :class:`_engine.ScalarResult` or
    :class:`_engine.MappingResult` objects with independent iteration
    progress over the same stored data.  When unique filtering was applied
    via :meth:`_engine.ScalarResult.unique` or
    :meth:`_engine.MappingResult.unique`, the unique values already
    delivered before freezing are retained, so that they are not delivered
    again by any copy produced from the frozen object.
